judgments.reason: The eLife study reports the EEG experiment in which participants detected targets in audio-visual noise. The authors match the dataset's (Waschke, Donoghue, Fiedler, Smith, Garrett, Voytek, Obleser), so it is the study paper for this data.
judgments.paper_title: Modality-specific tracking of attention and sensory statistics in the human electrophysiological spectral exponent
